## Summary

- What changed?
- Why was this change needed?

## Validation

- [ ] `pytest`
- [ ] Manual UI smoke check if UI behavior changed
- [ ] Hardware verification if serial/device logic changed

## Release Notes

- [ ] Changelog updated when user-facing behavior changed
- [ ] Version/tag impact reviewed

## Checklist

- [ ] Branch name follows `feature/*`, `bugfix/*`, `hotfix/*`, or `release/*`
- [ ] Commit history is clean enough to squash
- [ ] Related docs/configs were updated when needed
